Apple's September event is fast approaching, with the date likely to be announced next week. Here are over 10 new Apple products coming soon, most of which are expected to debut in September.

Here are all the new Apple products that could launch at or shortly after the September event

Apple's September event is traditionally the company's biggest product showcase of the year. There are always a few surprises, but new iPhone and Apple Watch models are almost certain to appear in September.

Here's what we expect this year:

In addition to these certain releases, another likely announcement is new AirPods with an infrared camera. They may be called AirPods Pro 4.

Apple often launches new AirPods at its September events, as they are marketed as iPhone accessories. A video leaked this week from macOS 26.7 offers the first glimpse of this long-rumored product.

In addition, four new Apple Home products are reportedly coming as soon as next month:

These 10 products are the most likely to be unveiled in September. Other possibilities include an OLED-equipped iPad mini, a home security camera, and even new Macs—though the latter is more likely to arrive in October.

Which upcoming Apple product are you most excited about? Let us know in the comments.
